tex_content.label: limittri
tex_content.html:
Every focusing triangle based in $J$ contains a component of $J\setminus X_J$. Every infinite sequence of such triangles has a subsequence converging to a focusing triangle. \end{claim}
Proof

↗ claim:local-embedding-of-geodesic-family \sketch The first conclusion follows from local embedding on each component of $X_J$. Compactness gives convergent sides; their initial points remain distinct because each base contains one of the finitely many components of $J\setminus X_J$.

□
